page.layout: One printed page, blank. The only marks are faint mirrored text from the reverse side (show-through) and a library stamp at the left.
page.notes: The page is blank apart from show-through: mirrored, faint text in the upper half (apparently a title, "IN EPISTOLAS ... Apostoli Pauli ad Galatas ... Ephesios ... Thessalonicenses", with a mirrored line and imprint lower down) and a faint woodcut or device in the centre. This is bleed-through from the printing on the other side and is not transcribed. The oval stamp at the left is a library stamp and is not transcribed. The digitiser's banner and footer are excluded.
